scope: One deterministic training-only ratio-of-ratios diagnostic after fixed mean-model v1 failed. No held-out model search, no WZZT, no future forecasting validation or causal elasticity claim.
matching: Match within identical Region. H2 is split into regions, then recombined by fixed eligible treatment household counts. OK status only after uppercase normalization, preserve all eligible IDs.

history.shared_dates: Treatment and its matched controls use the same eligible prior dates; these have no assigned experiment for that treatment group, of any menu type.
history.missingness: A stratum day is eligible only if every selected treatment and matched-control household has all 24 distinct finite nonnegative hours. Preserve excluded-day counts and reasons; do not silently drop households or interpolate.

model.raw_ratio: (mean treatment actual / mean treatment historical prediction) / (mean control actual / mean control historical prediction), for each stratum, date and band
model.normalization: Divide raw ratio by stratum-band mean raw ratio on training non-event weekdays excluding declared holidays, with valid history.
model.group_pool: Fixed treatment-household shares across all strata; require every stratum available that group-day.
model.menu_pool: Arithmetic mean of normalized original-group-day factors, each original group-day equally weighted.
model.constraints: No monotonicity, sign constraint, household elasticity, or participation probability. No realized weather covariate.

validation.type: Leave one whole training date out, all groups together; refit non-event normalization without that date and fit menu-blind common event band mean and menu-specific band means on the remaining event dates.
validation.outcomes: Normalized group-day ratio residual MAE and MSE; menu/band factor range across omitted dates; no held-out primary or late-test evaluation.
validation.history_in_loo: Historical loads from an omitted training date remain available to later dates if they occurred before that prediction deadline; this is date-level coefficient cross-validation, not a wholly unseen trajectory test.

boundary: Same-day controls are for training adjustment only and must never become future forecast features. Original v1 failure remains unchanged. Subsequent existing-test evaluation would be post-failure diagnostic, not a fresh untouched confirmation.
